title: [v1.84.0 (Release 3716) x64 STABLE] External Tools: Integration does not work reliable
author: judaspriest
body_snippet:
Hello :-)

This issue continues to show up more often than it should.

I created an External Tool, which was pinned to the "symbol bar" - it's a link to a VMWare vCenter, which shall be opened with MS Edge Browser and integrated inside the mRemoteNG Panel.

OS = Windows 11 25H2
MS Edge = 156.0.4314.50


External Tool looks like this:

Name: vCenter
File Name: C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe
Parameter: https://servername.domain.local/ui/ --edge-kiosk-type=fullscreen
W...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the exact tool definition, the Edge version and the log lines. The order of those lines is what explains it.

**What your log shows.** "Connection closed" arrives before the warning. That means the `msedge.exe` that mRemoteNG started had already exited while mRemoteNG was still looking for its window. Edge does that when an Edge with the same profile is already running: the new process hands the address to the running browser and exits. The page opens in your existing Edge window, ...

comments.author: judaspriest
comments.snippet:
You're amazing! It works!

By adding --user-data-dir=%LOCALAPPDATA%\mRemoteNG\Edge-vCenter --no-first-run before the hostname, the integration works perfectly fine for MS Edge links 👍 

I want to thank you for your ongoing good work! We are heavily using mRemoteNG with a 10 MB connection file containing 2500 entries. SSH, RDP, HTTPS, many self written powershell scripts, ... - so we really appreciate your help!

You can close the ticket now! 🥇
